parameters.description: Ordinary Markdown document enrichment over the dedicated inbox. Ships disabled: import compiles it; flip the wrapper's enabled toggle and re-import to activate.

parameters.content:
## Wax Documents Standard

Edges: the REQUIREMENT port (gated) says "this pass requires that one". The MAIN port (continue) only orders.

Title is GATED on Classify: the requirement edge means Title waits for — and is blocked by the failure of — Classify.

This workflow is an AUTHORING artifact. `wax pipeline import` compiles it into a frozen, versioned pipeline; n8n never executes it.
